introduction.title: Proverbs — book introduction
introduction.summary: Proverbs gathers wisdom instruction about speech, work, relationships and justice. It names reverence for the LORD as the beginning of knowledge. Its sayings are general principles, not mechanical guarantees.
introduction.authorship: The book names Solomon, the wise, Agur and Lemuel; its final form reflects multiple collections.
introduction.setting: The material reflects family instruction, leadership and everyday life in ancient Israel.
introduction.audience_and_purpose: Proverbs gathers wisdom instruction about speech, work, relationships and justice. It names reverence for the LORD as the beginning of knowledge. Its sayings are general principles, not mechanical guarantees.

structure.heading: Introduction and orientation
structure.summary: The book establishes its central questions and literary voice.

structure.heading: Exploration and instruction
structure.summary: Dialogues, prayers or sayings develop the central themes.

structure.heading: Conclusion and response
structure.summary: The closing material gathers the book’s challenge and invites faithful response.

interpretive_care: Proverbs are general principles, not unconditional guarantees.
Read sayings in literary context and attend to justice.

inductive_studies.title: The beginning of wisdom
observation: Identify the learners and stated purpose.
interpretation: Why is reverence for the LORD foundational to knowledge?
application: Choose one area where you can become teachable.

inductive_studies.title: Trust and direction
interpretation: What does wholehearted trust mean here?
application: Bring one decision to God in prayer.

inductive_studies.title: Wisdom calls publicly
interpretation: How is wisdom related to creation and justice?
application: Make one wise choice visible in public life.

quiz.prompt: What is the beginning of knowledge?
quiz.explanation: Proverbs 1:7 identifies reverence for the LORD as foundational.

quiz.prompt: Every proverb is an unconditional guarantee for every situation.

introduction.title: ምሳሌ — መግቢያ
introduction.summary: ምሳሌ መጽሐፍ ስለ ንግግር፣ ሥራ፣ ግንኙነትና ፍትሕ የጥበብ ትምህርቶችን ይሰበስባል። የእግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የእውቀት መጀመሪያ ነው ይላል። ምሳሌዎቹ አጠቃላይ መርሆች ናቸው።
introduction.authorship: መጽሐፉ ከሰሎሞን፣ ከጥበበኞች፣ ከአጉርና ከልሙኤል ጋር የተያያዙ ስብስቦችን ይጠቅሳል። የመጨረሻው ቅርጽ ብዙ ስብስቦችን ያካትታል።
introduction.setting: ትምህርቶቹ የቤተሰብ ሕይወትን፣ የመሪነት ሥልጠናንና ዕለታዊ ውሳኔዎችን ያንጸባርቃሉ።
introduction.audience_and_purpose: ምሳሌ መጽሐፍ ስለ ንግግር፣ ሥራ፣ ግንኙነትና ፍትሕ የጥበብ ትምህርቶችን ይሰበስባል። የእግዚአብሔርን መፍራት የእውቀት መጀመሪያ ነው ይላል። ምሳሌዎቹ አጠቃላይ መርሆች ናቸው።

structure.heading: የጥበብ ስብስቦች
structure.summary: ስለ ንግግር፣ ሥራና ግንኙነት አጫጭር አባባሎች።

interpretive_care: ምሳሌዎች አጠቃላይ የጥበብ መርሆች ናቸው፤ ሁሉን የሚያረጋግጡ ዋስትናዎች አይደሉም።

inductive_studies.title: The beginning of wisdom
interpretation: እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ለምን የእውቀት መጀመሪያ ነው?
application: ትምህርት ለመቀበል ዝግጁ የምትሆኑበትን አንድ ዘርፍ ምረጡ።

inductive_studies.title: Trust and direction
interpretation: በሙሉ ልብ መታመን ምን ማለት ነው?

inductive_studies.title: Wisdom calls publicly
interpretation: ጥበብ ከፍጥረትና ከፍትሕ ጋር እንዴት ተያይዛለች?

quiz.prompt: እያንዳንዱ ምሳሌ በሁሉም ሁኔታ የማይቀር ዋስትና ነው።
ጥበብ በግልጽ የምትጠራው በየትኛው ምዕራፍ ነው?
ሰው በሙሉ ልቡ በማን መታመን አለበት?
ምሳሌ መጽሐፍ ከአንድ በላይ ስብስቦችን ይዟል።
